issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'ουπω νοειτε' (you do not perceive/think) is rendered as a question 'Các ngươi chưa hiểu, chưa thông biết sao?' which misses the negative assertion of the Greek text.
The Greek 'ουπω νοειτε ουδε συνιετε' are two distinct verbs (perceive/think and understand). The Vietnamese combines them into a single question, losing the emphasis on the lack of perception.

The Greek 'ετι πεπωρωμενην εχετε την καρδιαν υμων' (do you still have a hardened heart?) is rendered as 'Lòng các ngươi còn cứng cỏi ư?' which is a question, whereas the Greek structure 'ουπω... ουδε... ετι...' functions as a series of negative assertions/exclamations regarding their lack of perception and understanding.
